risks.statement: Internet-reachable AI services or administrative paths can expand the opportunity for unauthorized access, exploit attempts, automated abuse, and resource exhaustion.
risks.circumstances: The risk is in scope when an internet-originated connection can reach an AI service, supporting interface, or administrative path in the assessed boundary.
source_basis: ESAF-1100 controls APP-150, API-110, INF-110, INF-120, INF-140, and MON-110

risks.statement: Unreconciled privileged access or configuration changes can bypass approved AI boundaries, alter protective settings, or prevent accountable reconstruction.
risks.circumstances: The risk applies to every assessed boundary because administrative identities, configuration states, and material changes support operation even when their implementation is inherited.
source_basis: ESAF-1100 controls IAM-120, IAM-130, IAM-150, INF-110, INF-130, and MON-150

risks.statement: Unsupported or end-of-life components can retain unresolved defects, lose dependable maintenance paths, and frustrate safe recovery or replacement.
risks.circumstances: The risk is in scope when component and support records identify any model, software, platform, protocol, or infrastructure element outside an approved support window.
source_basis: ESAF-1100 controls MOD-150, INF-120, OPS-150, and ARC-150

risks.statement: Models, code, packages, images, plugins, tools, or generated artifacts from untrusted paths can introduce malicious behavior, vulnerable dependencies, or unauthorized functionality.
risks.circumstances: The risk is in scope when externally sourced or otherwise untrusted software or model artifacts can enter development, evaluation, deployment, or operational paths.
source_basis: ESAF-1100 controls MOD-110, APP-140, API-120, and INF-120

risks.statement: External services or administrators can leave control ownership, access authority, change duties, evidence access, continuity, and exit responsibilities incomplete or inconsistent.
risks.circumstances: The risk is in scope when an external provider supplies a material service or when a third party can administer any component in the assessed boundary.
source_basis: ESAF-1100 controls API-140, API-150, CMP-120, ARC-140, IAM-130, and IAM-150

risks.statement: Incomplete system, asset, dependency, or evidence coverage can omit material control responsibilities and make assessment conclusions unreliable for the declared boundary.
risks.circumstances: The risk applies to every profile use because the package depends on a recorded system boundary, complete control population, resolved conditions, and traceable assessment evidence.
source_basis: ESAF-1100 controls GOV-130, RSK-110, IAM-100, MOD-100, INF-100, AUD-120, and ARC-110

overlays.statement: When internet exposure is present, the organization shall document every reachable service and administrative path, minimize permitted reachability, apply authenticated administration and risk-proportionate transport protection, and test detection and response for representative abuse and exploit paths.
overlays.strengthening_rationale: The overlay adds a current exposure inventory and tested boundary evidence while retaining each control's existing identity, protection, vulnerability, cryptography, abuse, and detection outcomes.

overlays.statement: The organization shall reconcile privileged identities, approved configuration baselines, material changes, and attributable audit events for the assessed boundary at a frequency justified by change and operational risk.
overlays.strengthening_rationale: The overlay connects access, configuration, change, and audit evidence for one declared boundary without changing the authorization, hardening, review, or audit-trail meanings of the affected controls.

overlays.statement: When an unsupported component is present, the organization shall record its affected capabilities, exposure, available maintenance and compensating measures, accountable disposition, time-bounded replacement or retirement plan, and verification of completed action.
overlays.strengthening_rationale: The overlay makes support-state evidence and disposition timing explicit while preserving the existing vulnerability, retirement, decommissioning, and technology-lifecycle requirements.

overlays.statement: When untrusted software intake is possible, the organization shall restrict intake to governed paths that record provenance, verify integrity, inspect dependencies and requested capabilities, perform risk-proportionate testing, and block artifacts that do not meet approved acceptance criteria.
overlays.strengthening_rationale: The overlay binds provenance, dependency, tool, vulnerability, and acceptance evidence to the intake path without redefining the affected supply-chain or assurance controls.

overlays.statement: When an external provider is used, the organization shall maintain a service-specific responsibility record covering security, data handling, change, incident, continuity, evidence access, dependency concentration, and exit ownership, and shall verify the record against current architecture and service terms.
overlays.strengthening_rationale: The overlay requires one reconciled provider-responsibility record while preserving the controls' existing integration, portability, supplier, and shared-responsibility outcomes.

overlays.statement: When third-party administration is present, the organization shall individually authorize, separately authenticate, time-bound where feasible, monitor, and periodically recertify each external privileged path, including its emergency and revocation arrangements.
overlays.strengthening_rationale: The overlay focuses existing privileged access, secrets, review, configuration, supplier, and responsibility controls on external administrative paths without changing their core requirements.

overlays.statement: The organization shall maintain a dated assessed-boundary record that reconciles the AI capability, business purpose, components, identities, models, hosting, dependencies, suppliers, condition answers, exclusions, limitations, and accountable owners to the evidence population used for assessment.
overlays.strengthening_rationale: The overlay joins ownership, classification, inventories, hosting, architecture, and assessment evidence into a profile-specific boundary record while preserving every underlying control meaning.
